investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Cortrel Bank (digital banking); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.208.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster cortre-prod-cacent (EKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 4gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the limits-svc PostgreSQL database limits-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
